decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis displacement initiates near index 442–444: N and E jump sharply and remain elevated; U rises then decays but stays offset. The sustained post-onset level without observed return within [400,485] makes the interval uncertain as temporary. No evidence of reversal or transient-only behavior; could represent onset of permanent offset or sustained motion.

intervals.observation: N and E show a sharp step-up near index 442–444 (≈+10 MAD), followed by sustained elevated levels through end of context; U rises concurrently (~+4 MAD) then gradually declines but remains above pre-step baseline. No return to pre-step levels observed within allowed context; interior is stable (plateau-like) in N/E, monotonic decline in U. Onset coherent across axes, but absence of opposing return prevents confirmation of temporary nature.
